test_title: PYST 4: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'ROBST' is written as 'QPYLO' and 'POLAR' is written as 'OXILM'. How will 'GUJRT' be written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (3) is subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• 'ROBST' is written as 'QPYLO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13b31f6e3ae15d1ec7052c87a512af8417768ebf8b833b31eab77630cf880b77.png] 

 
• 'POLAR' is written as 'OXILM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14645c91d38d8d70e7f8e58a3974063df8d34a9342afa677029fdfa5a542b378.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'GUJRT' is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d6cf4660c251670508d21a2ae8b0d37b3a5c3fe3568a789123dd2ee3f87554f.png] 

Hence, **"QOGRD**" is the correct answer.
